name: Motion design
about: A sample style for wide videos. One near-black canvas that a camera drags across. When you name a tool, a dark tile with a silver rim and its real logo lands on the word, joined to the last one by a dashed line, under a heading in your own words. A question you ask sits big in the middle, then the camera pans down and it rises into the heading. Between boards you have the whole frame: the camera eases in on you and moves you left or right, so the few animations land on the other side. Soft, simple sound cues on the moves. No captions.
format: talking-head YouTube videos: logos and questions on a dark canvas between shots of the speaker
